Case Study — Branchus Prediction Trajectory (After Using a Skill) Question. As of 22:30 ET on Friday 2026-09-25 (forecast made on 2026-09-24), which FDA outcome has been publicly announced for Mirum’s zilurgisertib NDA in FOP? The PDUFA goal date is Saturday 2026-09-26. Options: approved / crl / extended / none . Retrieved skill. Retrieve ​ ( q , a , 𝒮 ) \textsc{Retrieve}(q,a,\mathcal{S}) returns the skill “Forecasting a regulatory action that must be announced by a cutoff”. Search team trajectory ( τ s \tau_{\mathrm{s}} ). • Decomposition. Following s 1 s_{1} , the scheduler factors the question into decision × \times public by the cutoff from the first turn . In the baseline, this structure emerged only in the final search round, after the critic pushed back on none . Following s 3 s_{3} , it adds a sub-question the baseline never asked explicitly: on which weekday would FDA issue each outcome, and does this sponsor have US reporting obligations? Because Mirum is Nasdaq-listed, a Friday-issued CRL is expected to be announced the same day. • Retrieval. The checklist sends round 1 to two places at once: – verifying the premise from the 8-K and 10-Q; – a sweep of every announcement channel with timestamps: Business Wire, SEC EDGAR, FDA newsroom, Novel Drug Approvals list, and pdufa.bio. Round 2 is a single targeted pull of weekend-PDUFA precedents, recording action dates, announcement timestamps, and sponsor listing. The baseline spent three search rounds on this same evidence, including a partly failed round that re-checked a window it could not observe. Under the skill, the same evidence takes two rounds and one critic call. • Critique. The critic applies the s 2 s_{2} / s 3 s_{3} checklist: 1. It confirms that the chances of being public in time are outcome-specific (about 0.93 0.93 for approval, 0.45 0.45 for a CRL, 0.25 0.25 for an extension), not shared across outcomes. 2. It confirms that silence through ET Sep 23 is uninformative, because the expected action day is Friday Sep 25. 3. It flags that the Sohonos precedent supports the lesion-volume endpoint but not the failed primary endpoint, so a real CRL risk must remain. 4. It rejects using the stock’s unexplained 7% one-day drop and 11% slide as evidence about the decision. No news accompanied them, and the skill classifies such moves as weak. 5. It requires the 64–70% third-party odds to be used only as an upper check. • Evidence summary. – The premise is verified. Nothing has been announced on any channel as of ET Sep 23. There is no advisory committee and no major amendment. – Decision: approval about 0.60 0.60 , CRL about 0.36 0.36 , extension about 0.04 0.04 . * For approval: the randomised > 99 % >99\% volume reduction, durable to 48 weeks with clean safety, in an ultra-rare disease where about 97% of patients share one mutation; the rare-disease evidence principles; and a matched endpoint precedent. * For a CRL: the failed pre-specified primary endpoint in a single 63-patient trial, and the CRL risk flagged in Mirum’s own 10-Q. – Chances of being public by the cutoff: 0.93 0.93 / 0.45 0.45 / 0.25 0.25 . – Handed to the predict team: p ^ = ( 0.56 , 0.16 , 0.01 , 0.27 ) \hat{p}=(0.56,\,0.16,\,0.01,\,0.27) over approved / crl / extended / none . – Still unknown: the decisive window, ET Sep 24–25. Effect of the skill. The skill adds no new evidence; it changes how the same evidence is structured and weighted. The search splits the question into decision × \times public-by-cutoff from the first turn, uses outcome-specific chances of being announced in time, and stops letting an unexplained share-price drop move the decision probability. The forecast shifts from ( 0.52 , 0.16 , 0.02 , 0.30 ) (0.52,0.16,0.02,0.30) to ( 0.56 , 0.16 , 0.01 , 0.27 ) (0.56,0.16,0.01,0.27) , the reward rises from 0.827 0.827 to 0.854 0.854 , and the search takes two rounds instead of three. The larger gain is robustness: the worst unguided runs on this question made exactly the errors the skill’s critic checklist blocks (reading early silence as delay, or assuming every outcome is equally likely to be announced in time).

blocks.en: Case Study — Branchus Prediction Trajectory (After RFT) Question. As of 22:30 ET on Friday 2026-09-25 (forecast made on 2026-09-24), which FDA outcome has been publicly announced for Mirum’s zilurgisertib NDA in FOP? The PDUFA goal date is Saturday 2026-09-26. Options: approved / crl / extended / none . Predict team trajectory ( τ p \tau_{\mathrm{p}} , post-RFT). • Reconciliation. The fine-tuned predict team works from the same four search trajectories τ 1 , … , τ 4 \tau^{1},\dots,\tau^{4} . It does not settle conflicts by taking the middle value. It weights each claim by how well it was checked . – On the decision, the trajectories’ estimates of the approval share range from 0.53 to 0.60. The lowest comes from a critic who questioned the Sohonos precedent but never checked it. The trajectory that did check it found two things: FDA approved Sohonos on “new heterotopic-ossification volume”, and that approval rested on a weaker single-arm study. The verified claim outweighs the unverified objection. – The team also reads the failed primary endpoint more carefully. With only 6 events, p = 0.0986 p=0.0986 alongside an 81% reduction shows a trial too small to reach significance, not an absent effect. The large effect and the volume result point the same way. So the miss raises CRL risk, but less than a true null result would. – On timing, the team uses the most informative facts the trajectories found. It pools the precedents with duplicates removed: approvals were public by Friday in 6/6 cases, and CRLs in 2/6. • Base-rate reasoning. The team now states each step as an explicit update : 1. Decision prior. Start from the 2026 year-to-date approval rate on decision day, about 85%. Mark it down for the failed primary endpoint and the CRL risk flagged in Mirum’s own 10-Q. Move part of the way back up for the matched endpoint precedent, the rare-disease evidence principles, and the clean review record (no advisory committee, no amendment, no late-cycle issues). Result: approval 0.62 0.62 , CRL 0.34 0.34 , extension 0.04 0.04 . 2. Update on the silence. The baseline ignored this step. In the pooled precedents, one of six approvals was announced before the Friday, and nothing had appeared through ET Sep 23. Silence is therefore slightly less likely under approval (likelihood about 0.85 0.85 ) than under a CRL (about 0.95 0.95 ). Posterior: approval 0.59 0.59 , CRL 0.36 0.36 , extension 0.05 0.05 . The update goes against the favoured outcome, which shows calibration rather than confirmation. 3. Chances of being public by the cutoff, by outcome. – Approval: FDA dates approvals on weekdays and the sponsor announces the same day, so the team gives 0.93 0.93 , slightly below the 6/6 record because the sample is small. – CRL: about 70% of CRLs would be issued on the Friday, and a US-listed sponsor that receives one on a Friday announces it the same day about 75% of the time. That gives about 0.50 0.50 . A CRL dated Saturday would miss the cutoff. – Extension: about 0.25 0.25 . • Prediction. p ^ \hat{p} : – approved : 0.59 × 0.93 ≈ 0.55 0.59\times 0.93\approx 0.55 – crl : 0.36 × 0.50 ≈ 0.18 0.36\times 0.50\approx 0.18 – extended : 0.05 × 0.25 ≈ 0.01 0.05\times 0.25\approx 0.01 – none : the remaining 0.26 0.26 Selected option: approved . Rationale: approval is the most likely decision and almost certain to be announced in time; any announcement-lag risk falls mainly on a CRL. Confidence: moderate. Across reasonable inputs (decision approval 0.52–0.66, P(public ∣ \mid CRL) 0.35–0.60), approved stays between 0.48 and 0.61 and remains the selected option. Effect of RFT. The evidence is fixed; only the reasoning over it changes. The fine-tuned predict team: • weights claims by how well they were checked, instead of taking the middle value; • reads an underpowered miss for what it is; • adds an explicit likelihood update on the pre-window silence; • derives the CRL disclosure rate from the issue day rather than from a raw count; • reports how sensitive the forecast is to its inputs.
blocks.zh: 个案研究——分支预测轨迹(在RFT之后)问题。 截止2026-09-25(2026-09-24的预告)星期五的22:30 ET,Mirum的Zilurgisertib NDA在FOP中有哪些FDA结果被公开宣布? PDUFA的入球日期为2026-09-26星期六. 选项:批准 / crl / 扩展 / 无 。 预估出队轨迹(\\tau_{\mathrm{p}},后RFT). • 和解。 微调预测团队的工作来自相同的四个搜索轨迹 \ 1,...,\ tau 1},\ dots,\tau 4}。 它不能以中值解决冲突。 它根据对每项索赔的检查程度来衡量。 根据这项决定,轨道对批准份额的估计从0.53到0.60不等。 最低者来自一位批评者,他质疑索霍诺斯先例,但从未检查过. 检查的轨迹发现有两件事:林业发展局根据“新的异位-异位化量”批准了Sohonos,而批准与否取决于一项较弱的单臂研究。 经核实的索赔超过未经核实的反对意见。 球队还更仔细地阅读了失败的主终点. 仅有6起事件,p=0.0986p=0.0986加上81%的还原,表明审判太小,无法达到意义,而不是没有效果. 大效果和体积结果也指向了同样的方向. 因此,失事增加了CRL的风险,但低于真正的无效结果。 关于时间,团队使用发现的轨迹中最翔实的事实. 它将先例与删除的重复合并起来:在星期五之前,6/6个案例的核准是公开的,2/6个案例的核准是公开的。 • 基准率推理。 团队现在指出每个步骤, 1. 事先决定。 从决定日2026年至今的审批率起,约85%. 在Mirum自己的10Q中标出失败的主终点和CRL风险。 将部分路口挪回对应的终点先例,罕见疾病证据原则,以及清洁审查记录(没有咨询委员会,没有修正,没有后期问题). 结果:批准0.62 0.62,CRL 0.34 0.34,分机号:0.04 0.04. 2. 沉默的最新情况。 基线忽略了这一步骤。 在集合先例中,在星期五之前宣布了6项核准中的一项,在ET Sep 23中没有任何一项出现. 因此,与CRL(约0.95.0.95.)相比,核准沉默的可能性略小(大概为0.85.0.85.)。 事前:批准0.59 0.59,CRL 0.36 0.36,分机号0.050.05. 更新与偏好的结果相反,后者显示出校正而不是确认。 3. 截断时公开的机会,按结果分列。 – 说吧 – 批准:FDA在平日进行批准,主办方于同日宣布,因此团队给出了0.93 0.93分,略低于6/6记录,因为样本很小. – CRL:大约70%的CRL将在星期五发布,一个美国上市的赞助方在星期五收到一个,大约75%的时间当天宣布. 大约是0.500.50美元。 周六的CRL会错过停工 - 延期:约0.25.0.25。 p^\hat{p} : – 核准: 0.59×0.93 → 0.55 0.59\times 0.93\\ 约0.55 – crl: 0.36× 0.50\ 0.18 0.36\tims 0.50\\ 约0.18 — 延长: 0.05× 0.25\ 0.01\ 0.05\tims 0.25\ 约 0.01 — 无: 其余0.26 0.26 选定备选办法: 理由:批准是最可能的决定,并且几乎可以确定是否及时宣布;任何宣布日期的风险主要落在CRL上。 信心:温和. 通过合理投入(决定批准0.52-0.66, P(公共)\\中CRL)0.35-0.60),核准在0.48至0.61之间停留,并仍然是选定的选择。 RFT的效果. 证据是固定的;只有对证据的推理才会改变。 微调的预测小组:根据索赔的检查情况进行加权,而不是取中值; 读取不足的误差; 增加关于窗口前沉默的明显可能性; 将CRL的披露率取自发行日,而不是粗数; 报告预测对其投入的敏感性。

blocks.en: Finally, from the trajectory above, Athena ’s behaviour-level operator Φ skill \Phi_{\mathrm{skill}} turns the evaluated trajectory into a reusable skill. First, Eval judges the process one action at a time with the outcome withheld (Appendix D.3 ); then Extract and Filter distil the surviving experience — a single non-obvious action that helped — as a raw, unlevelled record (Prompt E.3 ); and finally Organize grades that experience into the four-level schema s = ( s 1 , s 2 , s 3 , s 4 ) s=(s_{1},s_{2},s_{3},s_{4}) of Section 4.4 , keeping the concrete procedure verbatim as s 4 s_{4} and generalizing it upward (Prompt E.3 ). The extraction and grading templates are those of Appendix D.4 .
blocks.zh: 最后,从上面的轨迹来看,雅典娜的行为级操作员\\Phi\ mathrm{skill}将评估过的轨迹转化为可再用的技能。 首先, Eval判断一次处理一次行动,结果被扣(附录D.3);然后取出和过滤器将幸存的经验——一个非明显的帮助——提炼成原始的、未平分的记录(Prompt E.3);最后将经历的分数组织入四级计划=(S 1、S 2、S 3、S 4)=(s_{1},s_{2},s_{3},s_{4}),将具体程序保持为s 4 s_{4}(Prompt E.3),并将其向上概括(Prompt E.3)。 提取和分级模板为附录D.4的模板。

blocks.en: Case Study — Extracted Experience (before grading) Role. scheduler Polarity. positive Scope. trajectory Experience. When the question resolves on whether an outcome has been announced by a fixed cutoff rather than on the outcome itself, factor it from the first turn into two independent sub-questions — (i) which outcome the authority decides, and (ii) whether that decision is made public before the cutoff — and assign a separate line of evidence to each. In this trajectory the decomposition into decision × \times public-by-cutoff let the search team gather outcome-specific announcement timing (approvals public by the preceding weekday in 6/6 precedents, CRLs in only 2/6) instead of treating “not yet announced” as neutral uncertainty, and it stopped early silence (through ET Sep 23, before the expected Friday action day) from being read as evidence against the pending action. source_refs . The scheduler decomposition step and the critic’s checklist in the search-team trajectory of Appendix E.2 (the decision × \times public-by-cutoff split and the outcome-specific timing base rates). Evaluation finding. High “decomposition / coverage” score on the scheduler: the split was the non-obvious action that let every later step attach the right evidence to the right sub-question. The matching negative experience is the baseline’s late discovery of the same structure — the split emerged only in the final search round.
blocks.zh: 个案研究——总结经验(叙级前) 排程极性。 积极范围。 当问题确定某一结果是否由固定的断接方式宣布而不是结果本身时,从第一次变成两个独立的分问题,即(一) 由当局决定的结果,以及(二) 该决定是否在断接之前公开,并为每个分出一行证据。 在此轨迹中,分解成决定xx逐一公布,让搜索组收集具体结果的宣布时间(在6/6的先例中,CRLs在前一周日公开批准,而只在2/6中批准),而不是将“尚未宣布的”视为中立的不确定性,它阻止了早期沉默(通过ET Sep 23,在预计的星期五行动日之前)被解读为反对未决行动的证据。 来源_ refs. 排程器分解步骤和附录E.2的搜索-团队轨迹中的批评者核对表(决定××分出公开截止和结果特定计时基准率). 评价结果。 排程器上的“分解/覆盖”分数很高:分解是非明显的动作,让以后的每一个步骤都把正确的证据附在正确的子问题上。 相匹配的负面经验是基线晚期发现同一种结构——分裂只在最后一轮搜索中出现.

blocks.en: Case Study — Graded Four-Level Skill (after grading) Role. scheduler Polarity. positive Four-level skill ( s 1 s_{1} most abstract, s 4 s_{4} the verbatim procedure; each level has a title , situation , instruction , and keywords ). • s 1 s_{1} — cross-domain principle. Title: Separate the event from its observation. Situation: the question resolves on whether something is observed (announced, reported, recorded) by a deadline, not purely on whether it happens. Instruction: decompose the target into “does the event occur” × \times “is it observed in time”, estimate the two independently, and combine them; never let an unobserved event default to a single residual bucket. Keywords: observation window, disclosure lag, decomposition. • s 2 s_{2} — domain specialization. Title: Model announcement lag for scheduled official decisions. Situation: a dated decision by an authority (regulator, court, central bank, standards body) that becomes public only when the authority or an obligated party releases it. Instruction: split the forecast into the decision and its public release, and build a release-timing base rate from comparable past decisions, keyed to the issuing calendar and the discloser’s reporting obligations. Keywords: regulatory decision, disclosure obligation, release timing. • s 3 s_{3} — question-type specialization. Title: Forecast an FDA action that must be announced by a cutoff. Situation: a PDUFA-dated NDA/BLA outcome ( approved / crl / extended / none ) that resolves on what is publicly announced before a cutoff near the goal date. Instruction: estimate the decision mix, then multiply each outcome by its outcome-specific chance of being public by the cutoff (approvals are dated on the preceding weekday and announced same-day; CRLs and extensions slip far more often), reading pre-window silence as uninformative when the expected action day is still ahead. Keywords: PDUFA, announcement cutoff, outcome-specific timing. • s 4 s_{4} — concrete procedure (verbatim). Title: Decision × \times public-by-cutoff split for Mirum’s zilurgisertib NDA. Situation: as of 22:30 ET Fri 2026-09-25, which FDA outcome is announced for the FOP NDA with a Sat 2026-09-26 PDUFA date. Instruction: from turn one, assign one evidence line to the decision (approval ≈ \approx 0.57–0.62, CRL ≈ \approx 0.34–0.39, extension ≈ \approx 0.04, from the randomised volume result vs. the failed primary endpoint) and another to timing (public-by-cutoff ≈ \approx 0.90–0.93 approval / 0.45–0.50 CRL / 0.25 extension, from pooled weekend-PDUFA precedents), treat silence through ET Sep 23 as uninformative, and combine. Keywords: zilurgisertib, FOP, weekend PDUFA. Grading. The extracted experience of Prompt E.3 is kept verbatim as s 4 s_{4} ; s 3 s_{3} generalizes it to any PDUFA-cutoff question, s 2 s_{2} to scheduled official decisions with a disclosure lag, and s 1 s_{1} to the cross-domain principle of separating an event from its observation. Each level stays within the scheduler’s contract (it decomposes and routes work; it neither searches nor makes the final forecast).
blocks.zh: 个案研究——四级技能(分级后) 排程极性。 正四级技能(s 1 s_{1}最抽象,s 4 s_{4) 逐字记录程序;每级都有标题,情况,指令,和关键词. • 第1 s_{1}——跨域原则。 标题:将事件与观察分开. 情况:问题在于是否在最后期限前观察到(宣布、报告、记录)某事,而不是是否发生。 指令:将目标分解为“是否发生事件” ×\times“是否及时观察到”,对两者进行独立估计,并将其合并;决不让未观察的事件默认为一桶残渣。 关键词:观察窗口,披露滞后,分解. · 第2 s_{2}——域名专业化. 标题:计划正式决定的示范公告滞后. 情况:当局(管理机构、法院、中央银行、标准机构)作出的日期决定,只有在当局或义务方释放时才公开。 指示:将预测分为决定和公开发布,并根据公布日历和披露者的报告义务,从过去类似的决定中制定释放计分基准率。 关键词:监管决定,披露义务,发布时间. • s 3 s_{3}——问题类专业. 标题:预测林业发展局必须宣布的禁产行动。 情况:一个PDUFA日期为NDA/BLA的结果(核准/crl/延长/无),解决在接近目标日期的截止日期前公开宣布的事项。 指令:估计决定组合,然后将每个结果乘以结果特定的机会被截断(批准日期为上个周日并宣布为同一天;CRL和扩展滑倒次数多得多),在预期行动日即将到来时将窗口前的沉默读作无信息. 关键词:PDUFA,公告截止,结果特定时间. • 第4 s_{4}——具体程序(口头)。 标题:决定 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\}Mirum's zilurgisertib NDA。 情况:截至22:30 ET Fri 2026-09-25,FOP NDA的FDA结果公布,日期为2026-09-26 PDUFA. 指令:从第一回合开始,给决定分配一条证据线(批准\\ 大约 0.57–0.62, CRL \大约 0.34–0.39,扩展\\ 大约 0.04,从随机量结果与失败的主终点)和另一个时间线到时间线(批准\ 大约 0.90–0.93,批准\ 0.45–0.50 CRL / 0.25,从集合的周末-PDUFA先例开始),将沉默通过ET Sep 23处理为非成型,并合并。 关键词:zilurgisertib,FOP,周末PDUFA. 渐入. Expoint E.3的抽取经验被保留为:s 4 s_{4};s 3 s_{3}将其概括为任何PDUFA禁用问题;s 2 s_{2}以披露滞后的预定官方决定;s 1 s_{1}将某一事件与其观察区分开的跨领域原则. 每一级都属于排程员的合同范围(它分解和路线工作;既不搜索也不作最后预测)。
